successCriteria.description: File `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts` exists and exports a `LeavePolicy` interface with exactly these fields: `id: string`, `policyName: string`, `leaveType: LeaveType`, `entitlementDays: number`, `accrualRate: number | null`, `maxAccumulation: number | null`, `minimumNoticeDays: number | null`, `requiresManagerApproval: boolean`, `isActive: boolean`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`.
`LeavePolicy` imports `LeaveType` from `../../shared/types/index` (the Phase 1 shared types module) — no other module dependencies.

File `src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts` exists and exports an `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface with exactly these seven methods: `findById(id: string): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>`, `findAll(): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`, `findByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`, `findActive(): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`, `create(policy: Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeavePolicy>`, `update(id: string, data: Partial<LeavePolicy>): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>`, `delete(id: string): Promise<boolean>`.
`ILeavePolicyRepository` imports `LeavePolicy` from `./policy.model` — no other module dependencies.
Both files compile under `tsc --noEmit` with strict TypeScript settings (no implicit any, strict null checks) and produce zero type errors.

constraints: No `any` types — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).

No database access in model or repository interface files — these are pure TypeScript interfaces with no implementation, no Knex imports, no SQL (HARNESS.json constraint `no-direct-db-outside-repository`; GP-001).
No barrel export (`index.ts`) in this sub-phase — that is owned by sibling sub-phase 4.3.
No unit tests in this sub-phase — tests are owned by sibling sub-phase 4.3.
outOfScope: Policy service interface and implementation (`policy.service.interface.ts`, `policy.service.ts`) — owned by sibling sub-phase 4.2.
Barrel export (`index.ts`) and unit tests — owned by sibling sub-phase 4.3.

entityInvariants.invariant: `leaveType` must be one of the `LeaveType` enum values (ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY, UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY). `entitlementDays` must be a positive integer. `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, and `minimumNoticeDays` are nullable — when non-null they must be non-negative numbers. `requiresManagerApproval` and `isActive` are required booleans. Lifecycle: a policy is ACTIVE when `isActive === true` and INACTIVE when `isActive === false`; the `isActive` flag is the sole lifecycle discriminator.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository interface level — auth is enforced at the service/controller layer (GP-005).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns the created `LeavePolicy` with `id`, `createdAt`, and `updatedAt` populated. The input is `Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>` — the caller must not supply these auto-generated fields.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository interface level.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Accepts `Partial<LeavePolicy>` — only supplied fields are updated. Returns the updated `LeavePolicy` or `null` if no policy with the given `id` exists.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository interface level.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `true` if a policy was deleted, `false` if no policy with the given `id` existed. Deleting a non-existent policy is not an error.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository interface level.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an array of `LeavePolicy` matching the given `LeaveType`. Returns an empty array (not null) when no policies match.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository interface level.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an array of `LeavePolicy` where `isActive === true`. Returns an empty array (not null) when no active policies exist.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `LeavePolicy.leaveType` must use the `LeaveType` enum from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — the same enum used by all other modules (Phase 1). Do not redefine or duplicate the enum.

The `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface must follow the same structural pattern as `IEmployeeRepository` (`src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts`) and `IAuditRepository` (`src/modules/audit/audit.repository.ts`): a single exported interface with async methods returning `Promise<T>`, using `Omit<>` for create inputs and `Partial<>` for update inputs, and `null` for not-found returns.

integrationPoints.why: `LeavePolicy.leaveType` references the `LeaveType` enum. `ILeavePolicyRepository.findByLeaveType` accepts `LeaveType` as a parameter. This is the policy module's sole external dependency.
